name: Context Window and Modality Discovery
description: Discover model capabilities at runtime by querying provider API metadata endpoints or model cards. Adapt prompts and tool schemas to fit model limits — truncate, chunk, or compress context to fit the available window, strip unsupported modalities, and adjust tool complexity to match model's tool-calling capacity.
purpose: Ensure requests never exceed a model's known limits by dynamically discovering capabilities and adapting request payloads to fit within the model's constraints.
acceptanceCriteria: Runtime discovery calls provider metadata APIs to fetch live capabilities
Prompt adapter truncates or summarizes context to fit context window limits with configurable strategy (truncate-head, truncate-tail, summarize-middle, chunk-and-recall)
Modality adapter filters out unsupported content types before sending
Tool-schema adapter prunes tool complexity (reduces parameter count, simplifies descriptions) for models with limited tool calling
All adaptations are reversible — original request preserved for retry on capable models
Discovery results cached with configurable TTL
System prompt auto-split or removal when model doesn't support it
